# Version 4.153.2 (Unreleased)
> **Failed-flush cache fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.2 incorporates an upstream Skia fix for stale cache entries after failed GPU flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed GPU flushes no longer retain stale cache entries** — Adopts the upstream m153 Ganesh cache fix so subsequent rendering work does not reuse entries left stale by a failed flush. ([#5265](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5265))
